segments.src: **2.** True or False — Cross-docking is a strategy for storing inventory longer to protect against demand spikes.
segments.tr: **2.** Vrai ou faux : le cross-docking est une stratégie consistant à stocker plus longtemps les marchandises pour se protéger contre les pics de demande.

segments.src: **3.** Which of these would you expect to cost the *most per unit shipped*?
segments.tr: **3.** Lequel de ces cas vous paraît coûter le *plus cher par unité expédiée* ?

segments.src: - A) Delivering full pallets to a retailer's regional DC
segments.tr: - A) Livrer des palettes complètes au centre de distribution régional d'un détaillant

segments.src: - B) Shipping cases to a retailer's store
segments.tr: - B) Expédier des cartons vers le magasin d'un détaillant

segments.src: - C) Picking and parcel-shipping one item to a customer's home
segments.tr: - C) Préparer et expédier par colis un seul article au domicile d'un client

segments.src: - D) All three cost about the same per unit
segments.tr: - D) Les trois coûtent à peu près le même prix par unité
## 📚 Termes du jour

segments.src: - **Distribution channel** — The route a product takes from producer to end customer, including any wholesalers, retailers, or marketplaces along the way.
segments.tr: - **Canal de distribution** — Le chemin suivi par un produit du producteur jusqu'au client final, en passant par les grossistes, détaillants ou places de marché intermédiaires.

segments.src: - **Distribution center (DC)** — A facility that receives bulk freight and replenishes stores or other DCs, mostly handling pallets and cases.
segments.tr: - **Centre de distribution (DC)** — Un site qui reçoit du fret en vrac et réassortit des magasins ou d'autres DC, en manipulant principalement des palettes et des cartons.

segments.src: - **Fulfillment center (FC)** — A facility built to pick, pack, and ship individual customer orders, handling single units and returns.
segments.tr: - **Centre d'exécution des commandes (FC)** — Un site conçu pour prélever, emballer et expédier les commandes individuelles des clients, en traitant des unités isolées et les retours.

segments.src: - **Cross-docking** — Sorting inbound freight straight onto outbound trucks with little or no storage in between.
segments.tr: - **Cross-docking** — Trier le fret entrant directement sur des camions sortants, avec peu ou pas de stockage intermédiaire.

segments.src: - **3PL (third-party logistics provider)** — An outside company you hire to warehouse inventory and fulfill orders on your behalf.
segments.tr: - **3PL (prestataire logistique tiers)** — Une entreprise externe que vous engagez pour entreposer votre stock et exécuter les commandes en votre nom.

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — Selling through several channels at once (store, website, marketplace, pickup) while trying to serve them from one inventory pool.
segments.tr: - **Omnicanal** — Vendre par plusieurs canaux à la fois (magasin, site web, place de marché, retrait) tout en servant ces canaux depuis un seul stock.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — C.** Two middle stops (wholesaler and retailer) between maker and shopper makes it a two-level channel.
segments.tr: *Réponses : **1 — C.** Deux intermédiaires (grossiste et détaillant) entre le fabricant et l'acheteur font un canal à deux niveaux.

segments.src: **2 — False.** Cross-docking does the opposite: it minimizes storage by moving freight from inbound to outbound trucks within hours, trading inventory buffer for speed and lower holding cost.
segments.tr: **2 — Faux.** Le cross-docking fait l'inverse : il réduit au minimum le stockage en transférant le fret des camions entrants vers les camions sortants en quelques heures, en échangeant le tampon de stock contre la rapidité et un coût de possession plus faible.

segments.src: **3 — C.** Picking a single unit means the most labor touches per item plus a dedicated parcel delivery to one address, so its cost per unit is far above pallet or case movement.*
segments.tr: **3 — C.** Préparer une unité isolée implique le plus de manipulations de main-d'œuvre par article, plus une livraison par colis dédiée à une seule adresse ; son coût unitaire est donc bien supérieur à celui du déplacement de palettes ou de cartons.*

pt.title: [Logistics 101 #10] Por que enviar uma única vela custa mais do que enviar mil

segments.src: > The route a product takes to reach you — the distribution channel — decides what kind of warehouse it has to pass through, and that decision drives most of the shipping cost you never see on the price tag.
segments.tr: > A rota que um produto percorre até chegar a você — o canal de distribuição — determina por qual tipo de armazém ele precisa passar, e essa decisão define a maior parte do custo de envio que você nunca vê na etiqueta de preço.
## Conceito de Hoje

segments.src: A **distribution channel** is simply the path a product travels from the company that makes it to the person who uses it.
segments.tr: Um **canal de distribuição** é simplesmente o caminho que um produto percorre desde a empresa que o fabrica até a pessoa que o usa.

segments.src: Channels are usually described by how many middle stops they contain:
segments.tr: Os canais costumam ser descritos pelo número de paradas intermediárias que contêm:

segments.src: - **Zero-level (direct-to-consumer):** maker → you. A brand's own website.
segments.tr: - **Nível zero (venda direta ao consumidor):** fabricante → você. O site próprio de uma marca.

segments.src: - **One-level:** maker → retailer → you. A jar of salsa sold at Kroger.
segments.tr: - **Um nível:** fabricante → varejista → você. Um pote de molho salsa vendido no Kroger.

segments.src: - **Two-level:** maker → wholesaler/distributor → retailer → you. How most small hardware stores and restaurants get supplied.
segments.tr: - **Dois níveis:** fabricante → atacadista/distribuidor → varejista → você. É assim que a maioria das pequenas lojas de ferragens e restaurantes se abastece.

segments.src: Here's the part that surprises people: the channel isn't just a sales decision.
segments.tr: Aqui está a parte que surpreende as pessoas: o canal não é apenas uma decisão de vendas.

segments.src: It quietly dictates your *logistics*, because each channel hands off goods in a different **unit of handling**.
segments.tr: Ele determina silenciosamente a sua *logística*, porque cada canal transfere mercadorias em uma **unidade de manuseio** diferente.
Pense em três tamanhos:
pallet  →  case  →  each (one single unit)
Um pallet pode conter 40 caixas.
Uma caixa pode conter 12 velas.

segments.src: Moving one pallet takes a forklift driver about a minute.
segments.tr: Movimentar um pallet leva cerca de um minuto para um operador de empilhadeira.

segments.src: Picking, packing, labeling, and shipping *one* candle takes a person a few minutes and a box, and then a parcel carrier charges you for a separate delivery to a separate house.
segments.tr: Separar, embalar, etiquetar e enviar *uma* vela leva alguns minutos de uma pessoa e uma caixa, e depois uma transportadora cobra por uma entrega separada para uma casa separada.

segments.src: That's why the cost per unit climbs steeply as the handling unit shrinks.
segments.tr: É por isso que o custo por unidade sobe bruscamente à medida que a unidade de manuseio diminui.

segments.src: Same product, same warehouse racks — completely different economics.
segments.tr: Mesmo produto, mesmas prateleiras do armazém — economia completamente diferente.

segments.src: This split shows up in the buildings themselves:
segments.tr: Essa divisão aparece nos próprios prédios:

segments.src: - A **distribution center (DC)** is built for *replenishment*. Trucks arrive with pallets, and trucks leave with pallets and cases headed to stores. Big doors, big equipment, few touches per item. Some DCs barely store anything at all — in **cross-docking**, inbound freight is sorted and reloaded onto outbound trucks within hours.
segments.tr: - Um **centro de distribuição (DC)** é construído para *reabastecimento*. Caminhões chegam com pallets e saem com pallets e caixas destinadas a lojas. Portas grandes, equipamentos grandes, poucos manuseios por item. Alguns DCs quase não armazenam nada — no **cross-docking**, a carga recebida é separada e recarregada em caminhões de saída em poucas horas.

segments.src: - A **fulfillment center (FC)** is built for *orders*. It receives cases but ships single units to thousands of individual addresses. It needs dense small-item storage, pick paths, packing stations, box selection, label printers, and a returns desk. Many touches per item.
segments.tr: - Um **centro de atendimento de pedidos (FC)** é construído para *pedidos*. Ele recebe caixas, mas envia unidades individuais para milhares de endereços diferentes. Precisa de armazenamento denso de itens pequenos, rotas de separação, estações de embalagem, seleção de caixas, impressoras de etiquetas e um balcão de devoluções. Muitos manuseios por item.

segments.src: **Fulfillment** is the name for that whole order-side sequence: receive → store → pick → pack → ship → handle returns.
segments.tr: **Fulfillment** é o nome de toda essa sequência do lado dos pedidos: receber → armazenar → separar → embalar → enviar → tratar devoluções.

segments.src: Companies either build it themselves or rent it from a **3PL** (third-party logistics provider) — an outside firm that stores your inventory and ships your orders for a fee, so you don't have to sign a warehouse lease.
segments.tr: As empresas ou o constroem por conta própria ou o contratam de um **3PL** (provedor terceirizado de logística) — uma empresa externa que armazena o seu estoque e envia seus pedidos mediante taxa, para que você não precise assinar contrato de aluguel de armazém.

segments.src: Most brands today run **omnichannel** — several channels at once.
segments.tr: Hoje a maioria das marcas opera em **omnichannel** — vários canais ao mesmo tempo.

segments.src: That creates a genuinely hard problem: one pool of inventory, many demand streams.
segments.tr: Isso cria um problema realmente difícil: um único estoque, muitas demandas.

segments.src: Sell the last unit on your website and in a store at the same moment, and someone's order gets canceled.
segments.tr: Venda a última unidade no seu site e numa loja ao mesmo tempo, e o pedido de alguém será cancelado.

segments.src: It also creates clever fixes, like **ship-from-store** (the nearest store becomes a mini-FC) and **BOPIS** — buy online, pick up in store — which shifts the expensive last mile onto the customer's own car trip.
segments.tr: Também surgem soluções engenhosas, como o **ship-from-store** (a loja mais próxima se torna um mini-FC) e o **BOPIS** — compre online, retire na loja —, que transfere a última milha, cara, para a viagem de carro do próprio cliente.
## No Dia a Dia

segments.src: Say you run a candle company in Portland, Oregon.
segments.tr: Imagine que você administra uma empresa de velas em Portland, Oregon.

segments.src: One product, one factory, three channels.
segments.tr: Um produto, uma fábrica, três canais.

segments.src: Watch what happens to the logistics.
segments.tr: Veja o que acontece com a logística.

segments.src: **Channel 1 — Target.** You sell wholesale at about $6 a unit.
segments.tr: **Canal 1 — Target.** Você vende no atacado por cerca de US$ 6 por unidade.

segments.src: You palletize, book a truck, and deliver to a Target regional distribution center; Target moves it to stores from there.
segments.tr: Você paletiza, agenda um caminhão e entrega em um centro de distribuição regional da Target; de lá, a Target distribui para as lojas.

segments.src: Your per-unit logistics cost is pennies to a few dimes, because you touched pallets, not candles.
segments.tr: Seu custo logístico por unidade é de centavos a alguns dimes, porque você manuseou pallets, não velas.

segments.src: The trade-off: thin margin, strict delivery windows and labeling rules, and you never learn who the buyer is.
segments.tr: O preço dessa escolha: margem apertada, janelas de entrega rígidas e regras de etiquetagem, e você nunca descobre quem é o comprador.

segments.src: **Channel 2 — your own Shopify store.** You sell at $28.
segments.tr: **Canal 2 — sua própria loja na Shopify.** Você vende por US$ 28.
Agora *você* é o centro de atendimento de pedidos.

segments.src: Someone in Cleveland orders one candle.
segments.tr: Alguém em Cleveland pede uma vela.
Ilustrativamente:
pick + pack labor      ~$2-3
box + dunnage          ~$1
parcel shipping        ~$8-10  (2 lb, cross-country, residential)
per-order cost         ~$11-14

segments.src: Then add returns and damage — modest for a candle, but in categories like apparel commonly 20–30% of online orders — with each one needing an inspection, a restock, and a refund.
segments.tr: Some devoluções e danos — modestos para uma vela, mas em categorias como vestuário costumam chegar a 20–30% dos pedidos online — e cada uma exige inspeção, reposição em estoque e reembolso.

segments.src: Great margin on paper, far less after the box leaves.
segments.tr: Ótima margem no papel, bem menor depois que a caixa sai.

segments.src: **Channel 3 — Amazon.** You ship cases to an Amazon FC in, say, Ontario, California, and Amazon picks, packs, and ships each order.
segments.tr: **Canal 3 — Amazon.** Você envia caixas para um FC da Amazon em, digamos, Ontario, Califórnia, e a Amazon separa, embala e envia cada pedido.

segments.src: You pay a per-unit fulfillment fee (a few dollars for a small, light item), monthly storage, and a referral fee that's commonly around 15% of the sale price in many categories.
segments.tr: Você paga uma taxa de fulfillment por unidade (alguns dólares para um item pequeno e leve), armazenagem mensal e uma taxa de comissão que costuma ficar em torno de 15% do preço de venda em muitas categorias.

segments.src: You've rented someone else's fulfillment operation — and inherited their rules about how everything must be boxed, barcoded, and forecast.
segments.tr: Você alugou a operação de fulfillment de outra empresa — e herdou as regras dela sobre como tudo deve ser embalado, codificado com código de barras e previsto.

segments.src: Notice that the candle never changed.
segments.tr: Repare que a vela nunca mudou.

segments.src: The *channel* changed, and the entire logistics design changed with it: truckload vs.
segments.tr: O *canal* mudou, e todo o desenho logístico mudou junto: carga fechada vs.
encomenda fracionada, pallets vs.
unidades avulsas, uma entrega vs.
milhares, nenhum balcão de devoluções vs.
um balcão movimentado.

segments.src: That's the whole lesson — and it's why the same brand can be profitable in one channel and quietly lose money in another.
segments.tr: Essa é a lição toda — e é por isso que a mesma marca pode ser lucrativa em um canal e perder dinheiro discretamente em outro.
## Resumo em 3 Linhas

segments.src: 1. A distribution channel is the path from maker to end user, and each added level changes who holds inventory and who takes the risk.
segments.tr: 1. Um canal de distribuição é o caminho do fabricante até o usuário final, e cada nível adicionado muda quem detém o estoque e quem assume o risco.

segments.src: 2. Distribution centers move pallets and cases to stores; fulfillment centers pick single units for individual shoppers, so cost per unit rises sharply as the handling unit shrinks.
segments.tr: 2. Centros de distribuição movimentam pallets e caixas para as lojas; centros de atendimento separam unidades individuais para compradores específicos, então o custo por unidade sobe bruscamente à medida que a unidade de manuseio diminui.

segments.src: 3. Running multiple channels at once (omnichannel) means one inventory pool serving several very different cost structures — which is exactly where profit gets made or lost.
segments.tr: 3. Operar vários canais ao mesmo tempo (omnichannel) significa um único estoque atendendo estruturas de custo muito diferentes — e é exatamente aí que o lucro é ganho ou perdido.
## ✅ Autoavaliação

segments.src: **1.** A brand sells through a wholesaler, who sells to independent grocery stores, who sell to shoppers.
segments.tr: **1.** Uma marca vende por meio de um atacadista, que vende para mercados independentes, que vendem para consumidores.
Qual é o nível do canal?
- A) Nível zero
- B) Um nível
- C) Dois níveis
- D) Omnichannel

segments.src: **2.** True or False — Cross-docking is a strategy for storing inventory longer to protect against demand spikes.
segments.tr: **2.** Verdadeiro ou falso — o cross-docking é uma estratégia de armazenar estoque por mais tempo para se proteger de picos de demanda.

segments.src: **3.** Which of these would you expect to cost the *most per unit shipped*?
segments.tr: **3.** Qual destes você esperaria que custasse *mais por unidade enviada*?

segments.src: - A) Delivering full pallets to a retailer's regional DC
segments.tr: - A) Entregar pallets completos no centro de distribuição regional de um varejista

segments.src: - B) Shipping cases to a retailer's store
segments.tr: - B) Enviar caixas para a loja de um varejista

segments.src: - C) Picking and parcel-shipping one item to a customer's home
segments.tr: - C) Separar e enviar por encomenda um item até a casa de um cliente

segments.src: - D) All three cost about the same per unit
segments.tr: - D) Todas as três custam aproximadamente o mesmo por unidade
## 📚 Termos de Hoje

segments.src: - **Distribution channel** — The route a product takes from producer to end customer, including any wholesalers, retailers, or marketplaces along the way.
segments.tr: - **Canal de distribuição** — O caminho que um produto percorre do produtor até o cliente final, incluindo quaisquer atacadistas, varejistas ou marketplaces no meio do caminho.

segments.src: - **Distribution center (DC)** — A facility that receives bulk freight and replenishes stores or other DCs, mostly handling pallets and cases.
segments.tr: - **Centro de distribuição (DC)** — Instalação que recebe carga a granel e reabastece lojas ou outros DCs, lidando principalmente com pallets e caixas.

segments.src: - **Fulfillment center (FC)** — A facility built to pick, pack, and ship individual customer orders, handling single units and returns.
segments.tr: - **Centro de atendimento de pedidos (FC)** — Instalação construída para separar, embalar e enviar pedidos individuais de clientes, lidando com unidades avulsas e devoluções.

segments.src: - **Cross-docking** — Sorting inbound freight straight onto outbound trucks with little or no storage in between.
segments.tr: - **Cross-docking** — Separar a carga recebida diretamente em caminhões de saída, com pouco ou nenhum armazenamento no meio.

segments.src: - **3PL (third-party logistics provider)** — An outside company you hire to warehouse inventory and fulfill orders on your behalf.
segments.tr: - **3PL (provedor terceirizado de logística)** — Empresa externa contratada para armazenar estoque e atender pedidos em seu nome.

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — Selling through several channels at once (store, website, marketplace, pickup) while trying to serve them from one inventory pool.
segments.tr: - **Omnichannel** — Vender por vários canais ao mesmo tempo (loja, site, marketplace, retirada) tentando atender todos a partir de um único estoque.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — C.** Two middle stops (wholesaler and retailer) between maker and shopper makes it a two-level channel.
segments.tr: *Respostas: **1 — C.** Duas paradas intermediárias (atacadista e varejista) entre o fabricante e o comprador tornam o canal de dois níveis.

segments.src: **2 — False.** Cross-docking does the opposite: it minimizes storage by moving freight from inbound to outbound trucks within hours, trading inventory buffer for speed and lower holding cost.
segments.tr: **2 — Falso.** O cross-docking faz o oposto: minimiza o armazenamento ao mover a carga da entrada para a saída em poucas horas, trocando o colchão de estoque por velocidade e menor custo de manutenção.

segments.src: **3 — C.** Picking a single unit means the most labor touches per item plus a dedicated parcel delivery to one address, so its cost per unit is far above pallet or case movement.*
segments.tr: **3 — C.** Separar uma única unidade significa o maior número de manuseios de mão de obra por item, mais uma entrega de encomenda dedicada a um único endereço, por isso o custo por unidade fica muito acima da movimentação de pallets ou caixas.*

in.title: [Logistik 101 #10] Mengapa Mengirim Satu Lilin Lebih Mahal daripada Mengirim Seribu Lilin

segments.src: > The route a product takes to reach you — the distribution channel — decides what kind of warehouse it has to pass through, and that decision drives most of the shipping cost you never see on the price tag.
segments.tr: > Rute yang ditempuh produk sebelum sampai ke tangan Anda — saluran distribusi — menentukan jenis gudang yang harus dilewatinya, dan keputusan itu mendorong sebagian besar biaya pengiriman yang tidak pernah terlihat di label harga.
## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: A **distribution channel** is simply the path a product travels from the company that makes it to the person who uses it.
segments.tr: **Saluran distribusi** adalah jalur yang dilalui produk dari perusahaan yang membuatnya hingga ke orang yang menggunakannya.

segments.src: Channels are usually described by how many middle stops they contain:
segments.tr: Saluran biasanya dijelaskan berdasarkan berapa banyak perhentian perantara yang dilaluinya:

segments.src: - **Zero-level (direct-to-consumer):** maker → you. A brand's own website.
segments.tr: - **Tingkat nol (langsung ke konsumen):** produsen → Anda. Situs web milik merek itu sendiri.

segments.src: - **One-level:** maker → retailer → you. A jar of salsa sold at Kroger.
segments.tr: - **Satu tingkat:** produsen → peritel → Anda. Sebotol salsa yang dijual di Kroger.

segments.src: - **Two-level:** maker → wholesaler/distributor → retailer → you. How most small hardware stores and restaurants get supplied.
segments.tr: - **Dua tingkat:** produsen → grosir/distributor → peritel → Anda. Cara sebagian besar toko perkakas kecil dan restoran kecil mendapatkan pasokannya.

segments.src: Here's the part that surprises people: the channel isn't just a sales decision.
segments.tr: Bagian yang mengejutkan banyak orang: saluran bukan sekadar keputusan penjualan.

segments.src: It quietly dictates your *logistics*, because each channel hands off goods in a different **unit of handling**.
segments.tr: Saluran diam-diam menentukan *logistik* Anda, karena setiap saluran menyerahkan barang dalam **satuan penanganan** yang berbeda.
Bayangkan tiga ukuran:
pallet  →  case  →  each (one single unit)
Satu palet mungkin berisi 40 kardus.
Satu kardus mungkin berisi 12 lilin.

segments.src: Moving one pallet takes a forklift driver about a minute.
segments.tr: Memindahkan satu palet membutuhkan sekitar satu menit bagi operator forklift.

segments.src: Picking, packing, labeling, and shipping *one* candle takes a person a few minutes and a box, and then a parcel carrier charges you for a separate delivery to a separate house.
segments.tr: Mengambil, mengemas, memberi label, dan mengirim *satu* lilin membutuhkan beberapa menit kerja orang dan sebuah kotak, lalu jasa kurir paket menagih biaya untuk pengiriman terpisah ke rumah yang berbeda.

segments.src: That's why the cost per unit climbs steeply as the handling unit shrinks.
segments.tr: Itulah sebabnya biaya per unit melonjak tajam ketika satuan penanganan semakin kecil.

segments.src: Same product, same warehouse racks — completely different economics.
segments.tr: Produk yang sama, rak gudang yang sama — ekonominya benar-benar berbeda.

segments.src: This split shows up in the buildings themselves:
segments.tr: Pemisahan ini terlihat pada bangunannya sendiri:

segments.src: - A **distribution center (DC)** is built for *replenishment*. Trucks arrive with pallets, and trucks leave with pallets and cases headed to stores. Big doors, big equipment, few touches per item. Some DCs barely store anything at all — in **cross-docking**, inbound freight is sorted and reloaded onto outbound trucks within hours.
segments.tr: - **Pusat distribusi (DC)** dibangun untuk *pengisian ulang stok*. Truk datang membawa palet, dan truk berangkat membawa palet serta kardus menuju toko. Pintu besar, peralatan besar, sedikit sentuhan per barang. Beberapa DC hampir tidak menyimpan apa pun — dalam **cross-docking**, barang masuk disortir dan dimuat ulang ke truk keluar dalam hitungan jam.

segments.src: - A **fulfillment center (FC)** is built for *orders*. It receives cases but ships single units to thousands of individual addresses. It needs dense small-item storage, pick paths, packing stations, box selection, label printers, and a returns desk. Many touches per item.
segments.tr: - **Pusat pemenuhan pesanan (FC)** dibangun untuk *pesanan*. Ia menerima kardus tetapi mengirim satuan tunggal ke ribuan alamat individual. Dibutuhkan penyimpanan barang kecil yang padat, jalur pengambilan, stasiun pengemasan, pemilihan kotak, printer label, dan meja retur. Banyak sentuhan per barang.

segments.src: **Fulfillment** is the name for that whole order-side sequence: receive → store → pick → pack → ship → handle returns.
segments.tr: **Pemenuhan pesanan** adalah nama untuk seluruh urutan sisi pesanan: menerima → menyimpan → mengambil → mengemas → mengirim → menangani retur.

segments.src: Companies either build it themselves or rent it from a **3PL** (third-party logistics provider) — an outside firm that stores your inventory and ships your orders for a fee, so you don't have to sign a warehouse lease.
segments.tr: Perusahaan dapat membangunnya sendiri atau menyewanya dari **3PL** (penyedia logistik pihak ketiga) — perusahaan luar yang menyimpan persediaan Anda dan mengirim pesanan Anda dengan bayaran, sehingga Anda tidak perlu menandatangani sewa gudang.

segments.src: Most brands today run **omnichannel** — several channels at once.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar merek saat ini menjalankan **omnichannel** — beberapa saluran sekaligus.

segments.src: That creates a genuinely hard problem: one pool of inventory, many demand streams.
segments.tr: Ini menciptakan masalah yang benar-benar sulit: satu kumpulan persediaan, banyak aliran permintaan.

segments.src: Sell the last unit on your website and in a store at the same moment, and someone's order gets canceled.
segments.tr: Jika Anda menjual unit terakhir di situs web dan di toko pada saat yang sama, pesanan seseorang akan dibatalkan.

segments.src: It also creates clever fixes, like **ship-from-store** (the nearest store becomes a mini-FC) and **BOPIS** — buy online, pick up in store — which shifts the expensive last mile onto the customer's own car trip.
segments.tr: Ada juga solusi cerdas, seperti **ship-from-store** (toko terdekat menjadi FC mini) dan **BOPIS** — beli online, ambil di toko — yang memindahkan pengiriman mil terakhir yang mahal ke perjalanan mobil pelanggan sendiri.
## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Say you run a candle company in Portland, Oregon.
segments.tr: Misalkan Anda menjalankan perusahaan lilin di Portland, Oregon.

segments.src: One product, one factory, three channels.
segments.tr: Satu produk, satu pabrik, tiga saluran.

segments.src: Watch what happens to the logistics.
segments.tr: Perhatikan apa yang terjadi pada logistiknya.

segments.src: **Channel 1 — Target.** You sell wholesale at about $6 a unit.
segments.tr: **Saluran 1 — Target.** Anda menjual secara grosir sekitar $6 per unit.

segments.src: You palletize, book a truck, and deliver to a Target regional distribution center; Target moves it to stores from there.
segments.tr: Anda menyusun palet, memesan truk, dan mengirim ke pusat distribusi regional Target; dari sana Target memindahkannya ke toko.

segments.src: Your per-unit logistics cost is pennies to a few dimes, because you touched pallets, not candles.
segments.tr: Biaya logistik per unit Anda hanya beberapa sen hingga beberapa dime, karena Anda hanya menyentuh palet, bukan lilin.

segments.src: The trade-off: thin margin, strict delivery windows and labeling rules, and you never learn who the buyer is.
segments.tr: Konsekuensinya: margin tipis, jendela pengiriman dan aturan pelabelan yang ketat, dan Anda tidak pernah tahu siapa pembelinya.

segments.src: **Channel 2 — your own Shopify store.** You sell at $28.
segments.tr: **Saluran 2 — toko Shopify Anda sendiri.** Anda menjual seharga $28.
Sekarang *Anda* adalah pusat pemenuhan pesanannya.

segments.src: Someone in Cleveland orders one candle.
segments.tr: Seseorang di Cleveland memesan satu lilin.
Sebagai ilustrasi:
pick + pack labor      ~$2-3
box + dunnage          ~$1
parcel shipping        ~$8-10  (2 lb, cross-country, residential)
per-order cost         ~$11-14

segments.src: Great margin on paper, far less after the box leaves.
segments.tr: Margin di atas kertas besar, tetapi jauh lebih kecil setelah kotak dikirim.

segments.src: **Channel 3 — Amazon.** You ship cases to an Amazon FC in, say, Ontario, California, and Amazon picks, packs, and ships each order.
segments.tr: **Saluran 3 — Amazon.** Anda mengirim kardus ke FC Amazon di, misalnya, Ontario, California, dan Amazon mengambil, mengemas, dan mengirim setiap pesanan.

segments.src: You pay a per-unit fulfillment fee (a few dollars for a small, light item), monthly storage, and a referral fee that's commonly around 15% of the sale price in many categories.
segments.tr: Anda membayar biaya pemenuhan per unit (beberapa dolar untuk barang kecil dan ringan), biaya penyimpanan bulanan, dan biaya rujukan yang umumnya sekitar 15% dari harga jual di banyak kategori.

segments.src: You've rented someone else's fulfillment operation — and inherited their rules about how everything must be boxed, barcoded, and forecast.
segments.tr: Anda telah menyewa operasi pemenuhan pesanan milik orang lain — dan mewarisi aturan mereka tentang cara semuanya harus dikemas, diberi barcode, dan diramalkan.

segments.src: Notice that the candle never changed.
segments.tr: Perhatikan bahwa lilinnya tidak pernah berubah.

segments.src: The *channel* changed, and the entire logistics design changed with it: truckload vs.
segments.tr: *Saluran*-lah yang berubah, dan seluruh desain logistik ikut berubah: truk penuh vs.
paket, palet vs.
satuan, satu pengiriman vs.
ribuan, tanpa meja retur vs.
meja retur yang sibuk.

segments.src: That's the whole lesson — and it's why the same brand can be profitable in one channel and quietly lose money in another.
segments.tr: Itulah inti pelajarannya — dan itulah sebabnya merek yang sama bisa menguntungkan di satu saluran dan diam-diam merugi di saluran lain.
## Ringkasan 3 Baris

segments.src: 1. A distribution channel is the path from maker to end user, and each added level changes who holds inventory and who takes the risk.
segments.tr: 1. Saluran distribusi adalah jalur dari produsen ke pengguna akhir, dan setiap tingkat tambahan mengubah siapa yang memegang persediaan dan siapa yang menanggung risiko.

segments.src: 2. Distribution centers move pallets and cases to stores; fulfillment centers pick single units for individual shoppers, so cost per unit rises sharply as the handling unit shrinks.
segments.tr: 2. Pusat distribusi memindahkan palet dan kardus ke toko; pusat pemenuhan pesanan mengambil satuan tunggal untuk pembeli individual, sehingga biaya per unit naik tajam ketika satuan penanganan semakin kecil.

segments.src: 3. Running multiple channels at once (omnichannel) means one inventory pool serving several very different cost structures — which is exactly where profit gets made or lost.
segments.tr: 3. Menjalankan beberapa saluran sekaligus (omnichannel) berarti satu kumpulan persediaan melayani beberapa struktur biaya yang sangat berbeda — di sinilah keuntungan diraih atau hilang.
## ✅ Kuis Mandiri

segments.src: **1.** A brand sells through a wholesaler, who sells to independent grocery stores, who sell to shoppers.
segments.tr: **1.** Sebuah merek menjual melalui grosir, yang menjual ke toko kelontong independen, yang menjual ke pembeli.
Ini termasuk tingkat saluran apa?
- A) Tingkat nol
- B) Satu tingkat
- C) Dua tingkat
- D) Omnichannel

segments.src: **2.** True or False — Cross-docking is a strategy for storing inventory longer to protect against demand spikes.
segments.tr: **2.** Benar atau Salah — Cross-docking adalah strategi untuk menyimpan persediaan lebih lama guna melindungi dari lonjakan permintaan.

segments.src: **3.** Which of these would you expect to cost the *most per unit shipped*?
segments.tr: **3.** Manakah di antara ini yang Anda perkirakan paling *mahal per unit yang dikirim*?

segments.src: - A) Delivering full pallets to a retailer's regional DC
segments.tr: - A) Mengirim palet penuh ke DC regional peritel

segments.src: - B) Shipping cases to a retailer's store
segments.tr: - B) Mengirim kardus ke toko peritel

segments.src: - C) Picking and parcel-shipping one item to a customer's home
segments.tr: - C) Mengambil dan mengirim satu barang melalui paket ke rumah pelanggan

## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini

segments.src: - **Distribution channel** — The route a product takes from producer to end customer, including any wholesalers, retailers, or marketplaces along the way.
segments.tr: - **Saluran distribusi** — Rute yang ditempuh produk dari produsen ke pelanggan akhir, termasuk grosir, peritel, atau marketplace di sepanjang jalan.

segments.src: - **Distribution center (DC)** — A facility that receives bulk freight and replenishes stores or other DCs, mostly handling pallets and cases.
segments.tr: - **Pusat distribusi (DC)** — Fasilitas yang menerima kiriman besar dan mengisi ulang stok toko atau DC lain, terutama menangani palet dan kardus.

segments.src: - **Fulfillment center (FC)** — A facility built to pick, pack, and ship individual customer orders, handling single units and returns.
segments.tr: - **Pusat pemenuhan pesanan (FC)** — Fasilitas yang dibangun untuk mengambil, mengemas, dan mengirim pesanan pelanggan individual, menangani satuan tunggal dan retur.

segments.src: - **Cross-docking** — Sorting inbound freight straight onto outbound trucks with little or no storage in between.
segments.tr: - **Cross-docking** — Menyortir barang masuk langsung ke truk keluar dengan sedikit atau tanpa penyimpanan di antaranya.

segments.src: - **3PL (third-party logistics provider)** — An outside company you hire to warehouse inventory and fulfill orders on your behalf.
segments.tr: - **3PL (penyedia logistik pihak ketiga)** — Perusahaan luar yang Anda sewa untuk menyimpan persediaan dan memenuhi pesanan atas nama Anda.

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — Selling through several channels at once (store, website, marketplace, pickup) while trying to serve them from one inventory pool.
segments.tr: - **Omnichannel** — Menjual melalui beberapa saluran sekaligus (toko, situs web, marketplace, pengambilan) sambil berusaha melayani semuanya dari satu kumpulan persediaan.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — C.** Two middle stops (wholesaler and retailer) between maker and shopper makes it a two-level channel.
segments.tr: *Jawaban: **1 — C.** Dua perhentian perantara (grosir dan peritel) antara produsen dan pembeli membuatnya menjadi saluran dua tingkat.

segments.src: **2 — False.** Cross-docking does the opposite: it minimizes storage by moving freight from inbound to outbound trucks within hours, trading inventory buffer for speed and lower holding cost.
segments.tr: **2 — Salah.** Cross-docking justru sebaliknya: ia meminimalkan penyimpanan dengan memindahkan barang dari truk masuk ke truk keluar dalam hitungan jam, menukar penyangga persediaan dengan kecepatan dan biaya penyimpanan yang lebih rendah.

segments.src: **3 — C.** Picking a single unit means the most labor touches per item plus a dedicated parcel delivery to one address, so its cost per unit is far above pallet or case movement.*
segments.tr: **3 — C.** Mengambil satu unit berarti sentuhan tenaga kerja terbanyak per barang ditambah pengiriman paket khusus ke satu alamat, sehingga biaya per unitnya jauh di atas pergerakan palet atau kardus.*

ja.title: [ロジスティクス101 #10] 1個のキャンドルの発送が、千個の発送より高くつく理由

segments.src: > The route a product takes to reach you — the distribution channel — decides what kind of warehouse it has to pass through, and that decision drives most of the shipping cost you never see on the price tag.
segments.tr: > 商品があなたの手元に届くまでの経路、つまり流通チャネルは、その商品がどの種類の倉庫を通るかを決め、価格タグには表れない配送コストの大部分を左右します。
## 今日のコンセプト

segments.src: A **distribution channel** is simply the path a product travels from the company that makes it to the person who uses it.
segments.tr: **流通チャネル**とは、商品を作る企業から、それを使う人に届くまでの経路のことです。

segments.src: Channels are usually described by how many middle stops they contain:
segments.tr: チャネルは通常、途中に何段階の中間業者があるかで説明されます:

segments.src: - **Zero-level (direct-to-consumer):** maker → you. A brand's own website.
segments.tr: - **ゼロ段階(直販):** メーカー → あなた。ブランド自身のウェブサイト。

segments.src: - **One-level:** maker → retailer → you. A jar of salsa sold at Kroger.
segments.tr: - **一段階:** メーカー → 小売業者 → あなた。Krogerで売られているサルサの瓶。

segments.src: - **Two-level:** maker → wholesaler/distributor → retailer → you. How most small hardware stores and restaurants get supplied.
segments.tr: - **二段階:** メーカー → 卸売業者/ディストリビューター → 小売業者 → あなた。多くの小規模な金物店や飲食店が仕入れている形です。

segments.src: Here's the part that surprises people: the channel isn't just a sales decision.
segments.tr: 多くの人が意外に思うのはここです。チャネルは単なる販売上の判断ではありません。

segments.src: It quietly dictates your *logistics*, because each channel hands off goods in a different **unit of handling**.
segments.tr: チャネルは、各段階で商品を異なる**取り扱い単位**で受け渡すため、知らないうちに*物流*を決めてしまうのです。
サイズは3種類を考えてみてください:
pallet  →  case  →  each (one single unit)
パレット1台には40ケースが入ることがあります。
ケース1箱には12個のキャンドルが入ることがあります。

segments.src: Moving one pallet takes a forklift driver about a minute.
segments.tr: パレット1台を動かすのに、フォークリフトの運転手は約1分かかります。

segments.src: Picking, packing, labeling, and shipping *one* candle takes a person a few minutes and a box, and then a parcel carrier charges you for a separate delivery to a separate house.
segments.tr: *1個*のキャンドルをピッキング、梱包、ラベル貼り、出荷するには、人の手で数分と箱が必要で、さらに宅配業者は別の家への配送を別料金で請求します。

segments.src: That's why the cost per unit climbs steeply as the handling unit shrinks.
segments.tr: そのため、取り扱い単位が小さくなるほど、単位あたりのコストは急激に上がります。

segments.src: Same product, same warehouse racks — completely different economics.
segments.tr: 同じ商品、同じ倉庫の棚でも、経済性はまったく異なるのです。

segments.src: This split shows up in the buildings themselves:
segments.tr: この違いは倉庫そのものの設計に表れます:

segments.src: - A **distribution center (DC)** is built for *replenishment*. Trucks arrive with pallets, and trucks leave with pallets and cases headed to stores. Big doors, big equipment, few touches per item. Some DCs barely store anything at all — in **cross-docking**, inbound freight is sorted and reloaded onto outbound trucks within hours.
segments.tr: - **物流センター(DC)** は*補充*のために作られています。トラックがパレットで入荷し、店舗向けのパレットやケースを積んで出発します。大きな扉、大型設備、商品1点に触れる回数は少なめです。ほとんど在庫を持たないDCもあります。**クロスドッキング**では、入荷した貨物を数時間以内に仕分けて出荷用トラックに積み替えます。

segments.src: - A **fulfillment center (FC)** is built for *orders*. It receives cases but ships single units to thousands of individual addresses. It needs dense small-item storage, pick paths, packing stations, box selection, label printers, and a returns desk. Many touches per item.
segments.tr: - **フルフィルメントセンター(FC)** は*注文*のために作られています。ケース単位で入荷しますが、何千もの個別の住所へ1個単位で出荷します。小物を高密度で保管する設備、ピッキング経路、梱包ステーション、箱の選定、ラベル用プリンター、返品窓口が必要です。商品1点に触れる回数が多くなります。

segments.src: **Fulfillment** is the name for that whole order-side sequence: receive → store → pick → pack → ship → handle returns.
segments.tr: **フルフィルメント**とは、注文側の一連の流れ全体を指す言葉です:入荷 → 保管 → ピッキング → 梱包 → 出荷 → 返品対応。

segments.src: Companies either build it themselves or rent it from a **3PL** (third-party logistics provider) — an outside firm that stores your inventory and ships your orders for a fee, so you don't have to sign a warehouse lease.
segments.tr: 企業はこれを自社で構築するか、**3PL**(サードパーティ・ロジスティクス事業者)から借りることができます。3PLとは、在庫を保管し、手数料を受け取って注文を出荷する外部企業のことで、倉庫の賃貸契約を結ぶ必要がありません。

segments.src: Most brands today run **omnichannel** — several channels at once.
segments.tr: 今日のほとんどのブランドは**オムニチャネル**、つまり複数のチャネルを同時に運営しています。

segments.src: That creates a genuinely hard problem: one pool of inventory, many demand streams.
segments.tr: これは非常に難しい問題を生みます:在庫は1つのプールなのに、需要の流れは複数あります。

segments.src: Sell the last unit on your website and in a store at the same moment, and someone's order gets canceled.
segments.tr: 自社サイトと店舗で同時に最後の1個を売ると、どちらかの注文がキャンセルになります。

segments.src: It also creates clever fixes, like **ship-from-store** (the nearest store becomes a mini-FC) and **BOPIS** — buy online, pick up in store — which shifts the expensive last mile onto the customer's own car trip.
segments.tr: 一方で、**店舗出荷**(最寄りの店舗をミニFCとして使う)や**BOPIS**(オンライン購入・店舗受け取り)のような巧みな解決策も生まれています。BOPISは、高コストなラストワンマイルを、顧客自身の車での移動に置き換えます。
## 日常生活の例

segments.src: Say you run a candle company in Portland, Oregon.
segments.tr: オレゴン州ポートランドでキャンドル会社を経営しているとしましょう。

segments.src: One product, one factory, three channels.
segments.tr: 商品は1つ、工場も1つ、チャネルは3つです。

segments.src: Watch what happens to the logistics.
segments.tr: 物流に何が起きるか見てみましょう。

segments.src: **Channel 1 — Target.** You sell wholesale at about $6 a unit.
segments.tr: **チャネル1 ― Target。** 1個約6ドルで卸売りします。

segments.src: You palletize, book a truck, and deliver to a Target regional distribution center; Target moves it to stores from there.
segments.tr: パレットに積み、トラックを手配して、Targetの地域物流センターに配送します。そこからTargetが各店舗へ配送します。

segments.src: Your per-unit logistics cost is pennies to a few dimes, because you touched pallets, not candles.
segments.tr: 1個あたりの物流コストは数セントから十数セントほどです。扱うのはキャンドルではなくパレットだからです。

segments.src: The trade-off: thin margin, strict delivery windows and labeling rules, and you never learn who the buyer is.
segments.tr: トレードオフは、利幅が薄いこと、納品時間や表示ルールが厳しいこと、そして買い手が誰なのか分からないことです。

segments.src: **Channel 2 — your own Shopify store.** You sell at $28.
segments.tr: **チャネル2 ― 自社のShopifyストア。** 28ドルで販売します。
この場合、*あなた自身*がフルフィルメントセンターになります。

segments.src: Someone in Cleveland orders one candle.
segments.tr: クリーブランドの誰かがキャンドルを1個注文します。
例として:
pick + pack labor      ~$2-3
box + dunnage          ~$1
parcel shipping        ~$8-10  (2 lb, cross-country, residential)
per-order cost         ~$11-14

segments.src: Then add returns and damage — modest for a candle, but in categories like apparel commonly 20–30% of online orders — with each one needing an inspection, a restock, and a refund.
segments.tr: さらに返品や破損もあります。キャンドルの場合は軽微ですが、アパレルなどのカテゴリーでは、オンライン注文の20〜30%に上ることも珍しくありません。どの返品にも、検品、再入庫、返金が必要です。

segments.src: Great margin on paper, far less after the box leaves.
segments.tr: 紙の上では利益率が高く見えても、箱が倉庫を出た後はずっと少なくなります。

segments.src: **Channel 3 — Amazon.** You ship cases to an Amazon FC in, say, Ontario, California, and Amazon picks, packs, and ships each order.
segments.tr: **チャネル3 ― Amazon。** ケース単位でカリフォルニア州オンタリオのAmazon FCに出荷すると、Amazonが注文ごとにピッキング、梱包、出荷を行います。

segments.src: You pay a per-unit fulfillment fee (a few dollars for a small, light item), monthly storage, and a referral fee that's commonly around 15% of the sale price in many categories.
segments.tr: 1個ごとのフルフィルメント手数料(小さく軽い商品なら数ドル)、月額の保管料、そして多くのカテゴリーで販売価格の15%前後になることが多い紹介料を支払います。

segments.src: You've rented someone else's fulfillment operation — and inherited their rules about how everything must be boxed, barcoded, and forecast.
segments.tr: つまり、他社のフルフィルメント事業を借り、その箱詰め、バーコード、需要予測のルールにも従うことになります。

segments.src: Notice that the candle never changed.
segments.tr: キャンドルそのものは変わっていないことに注目してください。

segments.src: The *channel* changed, and the entire logistics design changed with it: truckload vs.
segments.tr: 変わったのは*チャネル*で、それに伴って物流設計全体が変わりました:トラック一台単位の輸送 対
宅配便、パレット 対
ピース単位(eaches)、1回の配送 対
数千回の配送、返品窓口なし 対
忙しい返品窓口。

segments.src: That's the whole lesson — and it's why the same brand can be profitable in one channel and quietly lose money in another.
segments.tr: それが全体の教訓であり、同じブランドが一方のチャネルでは利益を上げながら、もう一方では静かに損失を出すことがある理由です。
## 3行まとめ

segments.tr: 1. 流通チャネルとは、メーカーからエンドユーザーに至る経路であり、中間段階が増えるたびに、誰が在庫を持ち、誰がリスクを負うかが変わります。

segments.src: 3. Running multiple channels at once (omnichannel) means one inventory pool serving several very different cost structures — which is exactly where profit gets made or lost.
segments.tr: 3. 複数のチャネルを同時に運営する(オムニチャネル)ということは、1つの在庫プールで、まったく異なるコスト構造の複数チャネルに対応することを意味します。利益が生まれるか失われるかは、まさにこの点で決まります。

## 📚 今日の用語

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — Selling through several channels at once (store, website, marketplace, pickup) while trying to serve them from one inventory pool.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — C.** Two middle stops (wholesaler and retailer) between maker and shopper makes it a two-level channel.
segments.tr: *答え: **1 ― C。** 生産者と買い物客の間に2つの中間段階(卸売業者と小売業者)があるため、二段階チャネルです。

segments.src: **3 — C.** Picking a single unit means the most labor touches per item plus a dedicated parcel delivery to one address, so its cost per unit is far above pallet or case movement.*

de.title: [Logistik 101 #10] Warum der Versand einer einzigen Kerze mehr kostet als der von tausend

segments.src: > The route a product takes to reach you — the distribution channel — decides what kind of warehouse it has to pass through, and that decision drives most of the shipping cost you never see on the price tag.
segments.tr: > Der Weg, den ein Produkt bis zu dir nimmt – der Vertriebskanal – bestimmt, durch welche Art von Lager es muss, und diese Entscheidung treibt den größten Teil der Versandkosten, die du nie auf dem Preisschild siehst.
## Heutiges Konzept

segments.src: A **distribution channel** is simply the path a product travels from the company that makes it to the person who uses it.
segments.tr: Ein **Vertriebskanal** ist schlicht der Weg, den ein Produkt vom Hersteller bis zu der Person nimmt, die es nutzt.

segments.src: Channels are usually described by how many middle stops they contain:
segments.tr: Kanäle werden üblicherweise danach beschrieben, wie viele Zwischenstationen sie enthalten:

segments.src: - **Zero-level (direct-to-consumer):** maker → you. A brand's own website.
segments.tr: - **Nullstufig (Direktvertrieb an Endkunden):** Hersteller → du. Die eigene Website einer Marke.

segments.src: - **One-level:** maker → retailer → you. A jar of salsa sold at Kroger.
segments.tr: - **Einstufig:** Hersteller → Einzelhändler → du. Ein Glas Salsa, verkauft bei Kroger.

segments.src: - **Two-level:** maker → wholesaler/distributor → retailer → you. How most small hardware stores and restaurants get supplied.
segments.tr: - **Zweistufig:** Hersteller → Großhändler/Distributor → Einzelhändler → du. So werden die meisten kleinen Baumärkte und Restaurants beliefert.

segments.src: Here's the part that surprises people: the channel isn't just a sales decision.
segments.tr: Der Teil, der die Leute überrascht: Der Kanal ist nicht nur eine Vertriebsentscheidung.

segments.src: It quietly dictates your *logistics*, because each channel hands off goods in a different **unit of handling**.
segments.tr: Er bestimmt still und leise deine *Logistik*, denn jeder Kanal übergibt Waren in einer anderen **Handhabungseinheit**.
Stell dir drei Größen vor:
pallet  →  case  →  each (one single unit)
Eine Palette fasst vielleicht 40 Kartons.
Ein Karton fasst vielleicht 12 Kerzen.

segments.src: Moving one pallet takes a forklift driver about a minute.
segments.tr: Eine Palette zu bewegen dauert einen Gabelstaplerfahrer etwa eine Minute.

segments.src: Picking, packing, labeling, and shipping *one* candle takes a person a few minutes and a box, and then a parcel carrier charges you for a separate delivery to a separate house.
segments.tr: Eine *einzelne* Kerze zu kommissionieren, zu verpacken, zu etikettieren und zu versenden dauert einen Menschen ein paar Minuten und einen Karton, und dann berechnet dir ein Paketdienst eine separate Zustellung an eine separate Adresse.

segments.src: That's why the cost per unit climbs steeply as the handling unit shrinks.
segments.tr: Deshalb steigen die Kosten pro Einheit stark an, je kleiner die Handhabungseinheit wird.

segments.src: Same product, same warehouse racks — completely different economics.
segments.tr: Dasselbe Produkt, dieselben Lagerregale – völlig andere Wirtschaftlichkeit.

segments.src: This split shows up in the buildings themselves:
segments.tr: Diese Aufteilung zeigt sich in den Gebäuden selbst:

segments.src: - A **distribution center (DC)** is built for *replenishment*. Trucks arrive with pallets, and trucks leave with pallets and cases headed to stores. Big doors, big equipment, few touches per item. Some DCs barely store anything at all — in **cross-docking**, inbound freight is sorted and reloaded onto outbound trucks within hours.
segments.tr: - Ein **Distributionszentrum (DC)** ist für die *Wiederbefüllung* gebaut. Lkw kommen mit Paletten an, und Lkw fahren mit Paletten und Kartons Richtung Filialen wieder ab. Große Tore, große Technik, wenige Handgriffe pro Artikel. Manche DCs lagern kaum etwas – beim **Cross-Docking** wird eingehende Fracht innerhalb weniger Stunden sortiert und auf ausgehende Lkw umgeladen.

segments.src: - A **fulfillment center (FC)** is built for *orders*. It receives cases but ships single units to thousands of individual addresses. It needs dense small-item storage, pick paths, packing stations, box selection, label printers, and a returns desk. Many touches per item.
segments.tr: - Ein **Fulfillment-Center (FC)** ist für *Bestellungen* gebaut. Es nimmt Kartons entgegen, versendet aber einzelne Einheiten an Tausende einzelne Adressen. Es braucht dichte Lagerung kleiner Artikel, Kommissionierwege, Packplätze, Kartonauswahl, Etikettendrucker und eine Retourenstelle. Viele Handgriffe pro Artikel.

segments.src: **Fulfillment** is the name for that whole order-side sequence: receive → store → pick → pack → ship → handle returns.
segments.tr: **Fulfillment** ist der Name für die gesamte Abfolge auf der Bestellseite: Wareneingang → Lagerung → Kommissionierung → Verpackung → Versand → Retourenabwicklung.

segments.src: Companies either build it themselves or rent it from a **3PL** (third-party logistics provider) — an outside firm that stores your inventory and ships your orders for a fee, so you don't have to sign a warehouse lease.
segments.tr: Unternehmen bauen das entweder selbst auf oder mieten es von einem **3PL** (Third-Party-Logistics-Dienstleister) – einem externen Unternehmen, das gegen Gebühr dein Inventar lagert und deine Bestellungen versendet, sodass du keinen Lagermietvertrag abschließen musst.

segments.src: Most brands today run **omnichannel** — several channels at once.
segments.tr: Die meisten Marken betreiben heute **Omnichannel** – mehrere Kanäle gleichzeitig.

segments.src: That creates a genuinely hard problem: one pool of inventory, many demand streams.
segments.tr: Das erzeugt ein wirklich schwieriges Problem: ein Bestand, viele Nachfrageströme.

segments.src: Sell the last unit on your website and in a store at the same moment, and someone's order gets canceled.
segments.tr: Verkaufst du die letzte Einheit gleichzeitig auf deiner Website und im Laden, wird jemandes Bestellung storniert.

segments.src: It also creates clever fixes, like **ship-from-store** (the nearest store becomes a mini-FC) and **BOPIS** — buy online, pick up in store — which shifts the expensive last mile onto the customer's own car trip.
segments.tr: Es entstehen aber auch clevere Lösungen, etwa **Ship-from-Store** (die nächstgelegene Filiale wird zum Mini-FC) und **BOPIS** – Online kaufen, im Laden abholen –, das die teure letzte Meile auf die eigene Autofahrt des Kunden verlagert.
## Im Alltag

segments.src: Say you run a candle company in Portland, Oregon.
segments.tr: Angenommen, du betreibst eine Kerzenfirma in Portland, Oregon.

segments.src: One product, one factory, three channels.
segments.tr: Ein Produkt, eine Fabrik, drei Kanäle.

segments.src: Watch what happens to the logistics.
segments.tr: Schau, was mit der Logistik passiert.

segments.src: **Channel 1 — Target.** You sell wholesale at about $6 a unit.
segments.tr: **Kanal 1 – Target.** Du verkaufst großhandelt zu etwa 6 $ pro Einheit.

segments.src: You palletize, book a truck, and deliver to a Target regional distribution center; Target moves it to stores from there.
segments.tr: Du palettierst, buchst einen Lkw und lieferst an ein regionales Distributionszentrum von Target; von dort verteilt Target die Ware an die Filialen.

segments.src: Your per-unit logistics cost is pennies to a few dimes, because you touched pallets, not candles.
segments.tr: Deine Logistikkosten pro Einheit liegen bei wenigen Cent bis ein paar Zehn-Cent, weil du Paletten angefasst hast, nicht Kerzen.

segments.src: The trade-off: thin margin, strict delivery windows and labeling rules, and you never learn who the buyer is.
segments.tr: Der Preis dafür: eine dünne Marge, strikte Lieferfenster und Etikettierregeln, und du erfährst nie, wer der Käufer ist.

segments.src: **Channel 2 — your own Shopify store.** You sell at $28.
segments.tr: **Kanal 2 – dein eigener Shopify-Shop.** Du verkaufst zu 28 $.
Jetzt bist *du* das Fulfillment-Center.

segments.src: Someone in Cleveland orders one candle.
segments.tr: Jemand in Cleveland bestellt eine Kerze.
Beispielhaft:
pick + pack labor      ~$2-3
box + dunnage          ~$1
parcel shipping        ~$8-10  (2 lb, cross-country, residential)
per-order cost         ~$11-14

segments.src: Then add returns and damage — modest for a candle, but in categories like apparel commonly 20–30% of online orders — with each one needing an inspection, a restock, and a refund.
segments.tr: Dazu kommen Retouren und Beschädigungen – bei einer Kerze gering, aber in Kategorien wie Bekleidung oft 20–30 % der Online-Bestellungen – und jede davon erfordert Prüfung, Wiedereinlagerung und Erstattung.

segments.src: Great margin on paper, far less after the box leaves.
segments.tr: Auf dem Papier eine großartige Marge, die aber deutlich schrumpft, sobald der Karton das Lager verlassen hat.

segments.src: **Channel 3 — Amazon.** You ship cases to an Amazon FC in, say, Ontario, California, and Amazon picks, packs, and ships each order.
segments.tr: **Kanal 3 – Amazon.** Du schickst Kartons an ein Amazon-FC, sagen wir in Ontario, Kalifornien, und Amazon kommissioniert, verpackt und versendet jede Bestellung.

segments.src: You pay a per-unit fulfillment fee (a few dollars for a small, light item), monthly storage, and a referral fee that's commonly around 15% of the sale price in many categories.
segments.tr: Du zahlst eine Fulfillment-Gebühr pro Einheit (ein paar Dollar für einen kleinen, leichten Artikel), monatliche Lagergebühren und eine Vermittlungsprovision, die in vielen Kategorien häufig bei etwa 15 % des Verkaufspreises liegt.

segments.src: You've rented someone else's fulfillment operation — and inherited their rules about how everything must be boxed, barcoded, and forecast.
segments.tr: Du hast die Fulfillment-Abläufe eines anderen gemietet – und übernimmst damit auch dessen Regeln, wie alles verpackt, mit Barcode versehen und prognostiziert werden muss.

segments.src: Notice that the candle never changed.
segments.tr: Beachte: Die Kerze hat sich nie verändert.

segments.src: The *channel* changed, and the entire logistics design changed with it: truckload vs.
segments.tr: Der *Kanal* hat sich verändert, und das gesamte Logistikkonzept hat sich mit ihm verändert: Lkw-Ladung vs.
Paket, Paletten vs.
Einzelstücke, eine Lieferung vs.
Tausende, keine Retourenstelle vs.
eine stark ausgelastete.

segments.src: That's the whole lesson — and it's why the same brand can be profitable in one channel and quietly lose money in another.
segments.tr: Das ist die ganze Lektion – und deshalb kann dieselbe Marke in einem Kanal profitabel sein und in einem anderen still Geld verlieren.
## Zusammenfassung in 3 Zeilen

segments.src: 1. A distribution channel is the path from maker to end user, and each added level changes who holds inventory and who takes the risk.
segments.tr: 1. Ein Vertriebskanal ist der Weg vom Hersteller zum Endnutzer, und jede zusätzliche Stufe verändert, wer den Bestand hält und wer das Risiko trägt.

segments.src: 2. Distribution centers move pallets and cases to stores; fulfillment centers pick single units for individual shoppers, so cost per unit rises sharply as the handling unit shrinks.
segments.tr: 2. Distributionszentren bewegen Paletten und Kartons zu Filialen; Fulfillment-Center kommissionieren einzelne Einheiten für einzelne Kunden. Die Kosten pro Einheit steigen deshalb stark, je kleiner die Handhabungseinheit wird.

segments.src: 3. Running multiple channels at once (omnichannel) means one inventory pool serving several very different cost structures — which is exactly where profit gets made or lost.
segments.tr: 3. Mehrere Kanäle gleichzeitig zu betreiben (Omnichannel) bedeutet, dass ein Bestand mehrere sehr unterschiedliche Kostenstrukturen bedient – und genau hier entsteht oder verschwindet der Gewinn.
## ✅ Selbsttest

segments.src: **1.** A brand sells through a wholesaler, who sells to independent grocery stores, who sell to shoppers.
segments.tr: **1.** Eine Marke verkauft über einen Großhändler, der an unabhängige Lebensmittelgeschäfte verkauft, die an Kunden verkaufen.
Welche Kanalstufe liegt vor?
- A) Nullstufig
- B) Einstufig
- C) Zweistufig
- D) Omnichannel

segments.src: **2.** True or False — Cross-docking is a strategy for storing inventory longer to protect against demand spikes.
segments.tr: **2.** Richtig oder falsch – Cross-Docking ist eine Strategie, Bestände länger zu lagern, um sich gegen Nachfragespitzen abzusichern?

segments.src: **3.** Which of these would you expect to cost the *most per unit shipped*?
segments.tr: **3.** Welches davon würde man *pro versendeter Einheit* am meisten kosten?

segments.src: - A) Delivering full pallets to a retailer's regional DC
segments.tr: - A) Volle Paletten an das regionale DC eines Einzelhändlers liefern

segments.src: - B) Shipping cases to a retailer's store
segments.tr: - B) Kartons an eine Filiale eines Einzelhändlers versenden

segments.src: - C) Picking and parcel-shipping one item to a customer's home
segments.tr: - C) Einen Artikel kommissionieren und per Paket an die Wohnadresse eines Kunden versenden

segments.src: - D) All three cost about the same per unit
segments.tr: - D) Alle drei kosten pro Einheit ungefähr gleich viel
## 📚 Begriffe des Tages

segments.src: - **Distribution channel** — The route a product takes from producer to end customer, including any wholesalers, retailers, or marketplaces along the way.
segments.tr: - **Vertriebskanal** – Der Weg, den ein Produkt vom Hersteller zum Endkunden nimmt, einschließlich aller Großhändler, Einzelhändler oder Marktplätze auf dem Weg.

segments.src: - **Distribution center (DC)** — A facility that receives bulk freight and replenishes stores or other DCs, mostly handling pallets and cases.
segments.tr: - **Distributionszentrum (DC)** – Eine Einrichtung, die Sammelfracht empfängt und Filialen oder andere DCs nachfüllt, vor allem mit Paletten und Kartons.

segments.src: - **Fulfillment center (FC)** — A facility built to pick, pack, and ship individual customer orders, handling single units and returns.
segments.tr: - **Fulfillment-Center (FC)** – Eine Einrichtung, die einzelne Kundenbestellungen kommissioniert, verpackt und versendet und dabei einzelne Einheiten und Retouren bearbeitet.

segments.src: - **Cross-docking** — Sorting inbound freight straight onto outbound trucks with little or no storage in between.
segments.tr: - **Cross-Docking** – Eingehende Fracht wird direkt auf ausgehende Lkw sortiert, mit wenig oder keiner Zwischenlagerung.

segments.src: - **3PL (third-party logistics provider)** — An outside company you hire to warehouse inventory and fulfill orders on your behalf.
segments.tr: - **3PL (Third-Party-Logistics-Dienstleister)** – Ein externes Unternehmen, das du beauftragst, deinen Bestand zu lagern und Bestellungen in deinem Auftrag abzuwickeln.

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — Selling through several channels at once (store, website, marketplace, pickup) while trying to serve them from one inventory pool.
segments.tr: - **Omnichannel** – Der gleichzeitige Verkauf über mehrere Kanäle (Laden, Website, Marktplatz, Abholung), wobei alle aus einem Bestand bedient werden.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — C.** Two middle stops (wholesaler and retailer) between maker and shopper makes it a two-level channel.
segments.tr: *Lösungen: **1 – C.** Zwei Zwischenstationen (Großhändler und Einzelhändler) zwischen Hersteller und Käufer machen es zu einem zweistufigen Kanal.

segments.src: **2 — False.** Cross-docking does the opposite: it minimizes storage by moving freight from inbound to outbound trucks within hours, trading inventory buffer for speed and lower holding cost.
segments.tr: **2 – Falsch.** Cross-Docking macht das Gegenteil: Es minimiert die Lagerung, indem Fracht innerhalb weniger Stunden von eingehenden auf ausgehende Lkw umgeladen wird, und tauscht Bestandspuffer gegen Geschwindigkeit und niedrigere Lagerkosten.

segments.src: **3 — C.** Picking a single unit means the most labor touches per item plus a dedicated parcel delivery to one address, so its cost per unit is far above pallet or case movement.*
segments.tr: **3 – C.** Die Kommissionierung einer einzelnen Einheit bedeutet die meisten Arbeitsschritte pro Artikel plus eine eigene Paketzustellung an eine Adresse, weshalb ihre Kosten pro Einheit weit über denen von Paletten- oder Kartonbewegungen liegen.*

segments.src: It also creates clever fixes, like **ship-from-store** (the nearest store becomes a mini-FC) and **BOPIS** — buy online, pick up in store — which shifts the expensive last mile onto the customer's own car trip.
segments.tr: Cũng có những giải pháp thông minh, như **ship-from-store** (cửa hàng gần nhất trở thành một FC mini) và **BOPIS** — mua online, nhận tại cửa hàng — chuyển chặng giao hàng cuối tốn kém sang chuyến đi bằng xe của chính khách hàng.
## Trong đời sống hằng ngày

segments.src: Say you run a candle company in Portland, Oregon.
segments.tr: Giả sử bạn điều hành một công ty nến ở Portland, Oregon.

segments.src: One product, one factory, three channels.
segments.tr: Một sản phẩm, một nhà máy, ba kênh.

segments.src: Watch what happens to the logistics.
segments.tr: Hãy xem logistics thay đổi thế nào.

segments.src: **Channel 1 — Target.** You sell wholesale at about $6 a unit.
segments.tr: **Kênh 1 — Target.** Bạn bán buôn với giá khoảng 6 USD mỗi đơn vị.

segments.src: You palletize, book a truck, and deliver to a Target regional distribution center; Target moves it to stores from there.
segments.tr: Bạn xếp hàng lên pallet, đặt xe tải và giao đến trung tâm phân phối khu vực của Target; từ đó Target đưa hàng đến các cửa hàng.

segments.src: Your per-unit logistics cost is pennies to a few dimes, because you touched pallets, not candles.
segments.tr: Chi phí logistics trên mỗi đơn vị của bạn chỉ vài xu đến vài hào, vì bạn chỉ thao tác với pallet, không phải từng cây nến.

segments.src: The trade-off: thin margin, strict delivery windows and labeling rules, and you never learn who the buyer is.
segments.tr: Đánh đổi là: biên lợi nhuận mỏng, khung thời gian giao hàng và quy tắc dán nhãn nghiêm ngặt, và bạn không bao giờ biết người mua cuối cùng là ai.

segments.src: **Channel 2 — your own Shopify store.** You sell at $28.
segments.tr: **Kênh 2 — cửa hàng Shopify riêng của bạn.** Bạn bán với giá 28 USD.
Lúc này *bạn* chính là trung tâm thực hiện đơn hàng.

segments.src: Someone in Cleveland orders one candle.
segments.tr: Một người ở Cleveland đặt mua một cây nến.
Minh họa:
pick + pack labor      ~$2-3
box + dunnage          ~$1
parcel shipping        ~$8-10  (2 lb, cross-country, residential)
per-order cost         ~$11-14

segments.src: Then add returns and damage — modest for a candle, but in categories like apparel commonly 20–30% of online orders — with each one needing an inspection, a restock, and a refund.
segments.tr: Rồi thêm hàng hoàn trả và hàng hư hỏng — với nến thì không nhiều, nhưng ở các ngành như thời trang, thường chiếm 20–30% đơn hàng online — mỗi trường hợp đều cần kiểm tra, nhập lại kho và hoàn tiền.

segments.src: Great margin on paper, far less after the box leaves.
segments.tr: Trên giấy thì biên lợi nhuận rất tốt, nhưng sau khi chiếc hộp rời khỏi kho thì con số ấy giảm đi nhiều.

segments.src: **Channel 3 — Amazon.** You ship cases to an Amazon FC in, say, Ontario, California, and Amazon picks, packs, and ships each order.
segments.tr: **Kênh 3 — Amazon.** Bạn gửi các thùng hàng đến một FC của Amazon, chẳng hạn ở Ontario, California, và Amazon lấy hàng, đóng gói và giao từng đơn.

segments.src: You pay a per-unit fulfillment fee (a few dollars for a small, light item), monthly storage, and a referral fee that's commonly around 15% of the sale price in many categories.
segments.tr: Bạn trả phí thực hiện theo từng đơn vị (vài đô la cho món hàng nhỏ, nhẹ), phí lưu kho hằng tháng, và phí giới thiệu thường khoảng 15% giá bán ở nhiều ngành hàng.

segments.src: You've rented someone else's fulfillment operation — and inherited their rules about how everything must be boxed, barcoded, and forecast.
segments.tr: Bạn đã thuê hoạt động thực hiện đơn hàng của người khác — và chấp nhận các quy định của họ về cách đóng hộp, mã vạch và dự báo.

segments.src: Notice that the candle never changed.
segments.tr: Hãy để ý rằng cây nến không hề thay đổi.

segments.src: The *channel* changed, and the entire logistics design changed with it: truckload vs.
segments.tr: *Kênh* đã thay đổi, và toàn bộ thiết kế logistics thay đổi theo: xe tải nguyên chuyến so với
bưu kiện, pallet so với
từng món lẻ, một lần giao so với
hàng nghìn lần giao, không có quầy hoàn trả so với
một quầy hoàn trả bận rộn.

segments.src: That's the whole lesson — and it's why the same brand can be profitable in one channel and quietly lose money in another.
segments.tr: Đó là toàn bộ bài học — và cũng là lý do cùng một thương hiệu có thể sinh lời ở kênh này nhưng âm thầm thua lỗ ở kênh khác.
## Tóm tắt 3 dòng

segments.src: 1. A distribution channel is the path from maker to end user, and each added level changes who holds inventory and who takes the risk.
segments.tr: 1. Kênh phân phối là con đường từ nhà sản xuất đến người dùng cuối, và mỗi cấp trung gian được thêm vào sẽ thay đổi bên nắm giữ tồn kho và bên chịu rủi ro.

segments.src: 2. Distribution centers move pallets and cases to stores; fulfillment centers pick single units for individual shoppers, so cost per unit rises sharply as the handling unit shrinks.
segments.tr: 2. Trung tâm phân phối di chuyển pallet và thùng hàng đến cửa hàng; trung tâm thực hiện đơn hàng lấy từng món lẻ cho từng khách mua, nên chi phí trên mỗi đơn vị tăng mạnh khi đơn vị xử lý càng nhỏ.

segments.src: 3. Running multiple channels at once (omnichannel) means one inventory pool serving several very different cost structures — which is exactly where profit gets made or lost.
segments.tr: 3. Vận hành nhiều kênh cùng lúc (đa kênh/omnichannel) nghĩa là một nguồn tồn kho phục vụ nhiều cấu trúc chi phí rất khác nhau — và đó chính là nơi lợi nhuận được tạo ra hoặc mất đi.
## ✅ Tự kiểm tra

segments.src: **1.** A brand sells through a wholesaler, who sells to independent grocery stores, who sell to shoppers.
segments.tr: **1.** Một thương hiệu bán qua nhà bán buôn, nhà bán buôn bán cho các cửa hàng tạp hóa độc lập, rồi các cửa hàng này bán cho người mua sắm.
Đây là kênh thuộc cấp nào?
- A) Không cấp
- B) Một cấp
- C) Hai cấp
- D) Đa kênh (omnichannel)

segments.src: **2.** True or False — Cross-docking is a strategy for storing inventory longer to protect against demand spikes.
segments.tr: **2.** Đúng hay Sai — Cross-docking là chiến lược lưu kho lâu hơn để phòng trước các đợt tăng nhu cầu đột biến.

segments.src: **3.** Which of these would you expect to cost the *most per unit shipped*?
segments.tr: **3.** Trong các phương án sau, phương án nào bạn cho là tốn *chi phí trên mỗi đơn vị giao* nhiều nhất?

segments.src: - A) Delivering full pallets to a retailer's regional DC
segments.tr: - A) Giao nguyên pallet đến trung tâm phân phối khu vực của nhà bán lẻ

segments.src: - B) Shipping cases to a retailer's store
segments.tr: - B) Giao từng thùng đến cửa hàng của nhà bán lẻ

segments.src: - C) Picking and parcel-shipping one item to a customer's home
segments.tr: - C) Lấy hàng và giao bưu kiện từng món đến nhà khách hàng

segments.src: - D) All three cost about the same per unit
segments.tr: - D) Cả ba có chi phí trên mỗi đơn vị gần như bằng nhau
## 📚 Thuật ngữ hôm nay

segments.src: - **Distribution channel** — The route a product takes from producer to end customer, including any wholesalers, retailers, or marketplaces along the way.
segments.tr: - **Kênh phân phối** — Tuyến đường sản phẩm đi từ nhà sản xuất đến khách hàng cuối, bao gồm mọi nhà bán buôn, nhà bán lẻ hoặc sàn thương mại điện tử trên đường đi.

segments.src: - **Distribution center (DC)** — A facility that receives bulk freight and replenishes stores or other DCs, mostly handling pallets and cases.
segments.tr: - **Trung tâm phân phối (DC)** — Cơ sở nhận hàng hóa số lượng lớn và bổ sung hàng cho cửa hàng hoặc các DC khác, chủ yếu xử lý pallet và thùng hàng.

segments.src: - **Fulfillment center (FC)** — A facility built to pick, pack, and ship individual customer orders, handling single units and returns.
segments.tr: - **Trung tâm thực hiện đơn hàng (FC)** — Cơ sở được xây để lấy hàng, đóng gói và giao từng đơn hàng của khách, xử lý món lẻ và hoàn trả.

segments.src: - **Cross-docking** — Sorting inbound freight straight onto outbound trucks with little or no storage in between.
segments.tr: - **Cross-docking** — Phân loại hàng nhập và chuyển thẳng sang xe tải xuất, với ít hoặc không lưu kho ở giữa.

segments.src: - **3PL (third-party logistics provider)** — An outside company you hire to warehouse inventory and fulfill orders on your behalf.
segments.tr: - **3PL (nhà cung cấp logistics bên thứ ba)** — Doanh nghiệp bên ngoài mà bạn thuê để lưu kho hàng hóa và thực hiện đơn hàng thay mình.

segments.src: - **Omnichannel** — Selling through several channels at once (store, website, marketplace, pickup) while trying to serve them from one inventory pool.
segments.tr: - **Đa kênh (Omnichannel)** — Bán hàng qua nhiều kênh cùng lúc (cửa hàng, website, sàn thương mại điện tử, nhận tại điểm) nhưng cố gắng phục vụ tất cả từ một nguồn tồn kho.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — C.** Two middle stops (wholesaler and retailer) between maker and shopper makes it a two-level channel.
segments.tr: *Đáp án: **1 — C.** Hai điểm trung gian (nhà bán buôn và nhà bán lẻ) giữa nhà sản xuất và người mua khiến đây là kênh hai cấp.

segments.src: **2 — False.** Cross-docking does the opposite: it minimizes storage by moving freight from inbound to outbound trucks within hours, trading inventory buffer for speed and lower holding cost.
segments.tr: **2 — Sai.** Cross-docking làm điều ngược lại: nó giảm thiểu lưu kho bằng cách chuyển hàng từ xe tải nhập sang xe tải xuất trong vòng vài giờ, đánh đổi lớp đệm tồn kho lấy tốc độ và chi phí lưu giữ thấp hơn.

segments.src: **3 — C.** Picking a single unit means the most labor touches per item plus a dedicated parcel delivery to one address, so its cost per unit is far above pallet or case movement.*
segments.tr: **3 — C.** Lấy một đơn vị đơn lẻ nghĩa là số thao tác lao động trên mỗi món hàng là nhiều nhất, cộng thêm một chuyến giao bưu kiện riêng đến một địa chỉ, nên chi phí trên mỗi đơn vị cao hơn nhiều so với vận chuyển pallet hoặc thùng.*
